text_block_list.text: One day, shortly before her debut race.
(Dadadadada...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Well, that is—

Out on the grounds were three classmates
set to debut in the same year.
A daughter of the 'Rose Clan,' whose lineage traces back to a noble Umamusume from France—Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*, *huff*... *huff*...
Can't break 12 seconds in the final furlong, huh.
—One more time."

The clan's desire is to make their standing as unshakable
as a kingdom. Hence, their expectations for her—a capable
contender truly fit to be king—seem exceptionally high.
"And then, there is the brainy Umamusume who deeply loves board games—Rulership."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"We have most of the cards in hand.
However, each and every one of them requires an upgrade."

A prodigy who mastered the fundamentals at the racing school run by "Empress" Air Groove's mother.
She aims for victory by controlling the board like a game.

And the international student Umamusume from Germany
who recently finished her debut race—
Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Drei... zwei... eins—
Haaaah!!
A methodical Umamusume who runs on a minute-by-minute schedule. She respects and loves her parents above all else, and her dream is seemingly to become just like them.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~. Flash-san only just debuted, right?
And she's got that kind of acceleration? Built different~...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Rose-san and Ruler-san
haven't even debuted yet.
And they're already powering through that training menu...

The three went through their training routine matter-of-factly.
The onlookers watched them from a distance, the grounds filled with a hushed, breathless murmur.
choice_data_list: Your class is full of tough rivals.
Your class is full of tough rivals, huh.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Everyone is so full of talent.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
That is precisely why I want to invite them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Would you care to join me for dinner after this?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. How about the four of us...
Rose-san, Ruler-san,
Flash-san, and me?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have to attend a family gathering after this.
I don't think I'll have time for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah... sorry, but I'll pass too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to finish today's meal quickly.
I have plans to isolate the components
necessary for the next phase.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but
I must decline for today as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Today's dinner is scheduled for 13 minutes, so I have no time for conversation."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...
Understood. Please let me invite you again sometime.

Unfortunately, we didn't end up having a meal together, but...
Still, why did they suddenly start asking me out to dinner in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When I learned we'd be debuting around the same time,
there was something I had been thinking about.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I want to strongly connect our circle of peers.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Just having someone to exchange greetings with as an equal boosts my motivation for training.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The stronger and deeper that relationship is... the more invaluable it becomes for both of you, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I believe that creating such a circle of bonds
is truly necessary in the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: I see. And so, for dinner...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Besides."
With those words, Victoire Pisa glanced my way as if trying to gauge my reaction.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, Trainer,
I was thinking we could hold joint training sessions
on a regular basis.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I was hoping we could build a relationship where we elevate each other.

The three peers are all at a very high level.
There certainly shouldn't be any downside to training together.

Judging from how she acted earlier,
building bonds with her peers seems to be quite important to her.
choice_data_list: Joint training? I don't mind at all.
A joint training session? Sounds fine to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...! Is that so,
thank you very much♪
...However.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I apologize, but—please allow me to decline.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I stepped into the Twinkle Series
to bring glory to the House of Roses."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must keep reaching out and revive
the withered bundle of dreams.
This is a vital mission upon which our clan's fate rests.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I—must press forward.
Single-mindedly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your offer.
However, I must decline. ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It didn't work out. Or rather—
choice_data_list: Didn't seem like they had the luxury for that.
It really didn't seem like you had the time for that, did it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
They seemed intent on moving forward no matter what—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The weight she carries is immeasurable.
However... seeing how she is right now makes me worry.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If only I could loosen the tension in my heart,
even once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is there any good way
we could help Rose-san relax?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I must accomplish this.
I, and only I...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Rose-san!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There is something I would like you to see.
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"...What might it be?
If you'd allow me, I'll take a look."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Now then, please watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This is an empty space.
I cover it with a red cloth, and count to three.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, here, a refreshment for you♪
It's sweet and very delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah... ...
...Thank... you... You're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san, you left something behind
in the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. How could I...
I'm sorry, um... what was it that I forgot?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, um... well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: A classmate's... smile...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...? What's this?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's an eye mask.
With its soft wild rose fragrance, it just made me think of Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, have one if you'd like.
It will help you sleep soundly.

Bringing a smile to Rose Kingdom's face time and again.
Training diligently day after day through all of that—
the day of the debut race has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's an 1800m turf debut race. All eyes are on the promising newcomer, Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And one more person—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Carrying the name of the Rose Clan,
it's Rose Kingdom!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
I'll be the one to start it all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Become the first arrow of an eternal kingdom...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I can't believe my debut race is going to be against Rose...!
choice_data_list: That's quite a coincidence, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. She is a formidable rival. As a fellow runner, it does make me a little nervous, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...As a friend, I am happy
to be able to run alongside her today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Still, Rose Kingdom seems a little on edge, doesn't she...? If I remember right, isn't she shouldering the fate of the "Rose Clan"?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's feeling the pressure.
Like she can't afford to stumble right at the start.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Rose-san!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of beginnings.
A turning point, of sorts—one that will foretell the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Let us both run a race with no regrets.
Best of luck out there."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, likewise.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Before that,
do you have a moment?"
Saying so, Victoire Pisa gently stroked the furrowed brow on Rose Kingdom's forehead.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: There was just so much resolve gathered in one place that, um... I offered a prayer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Praying that she may run in good health.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, hehe. Hahaha...!
Haha...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I thought there was something strange
about you lately, but...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I see...
...—"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
You're right about that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, I'm counting on you.
Let's have fun, Pisa."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Praying for our long journey ahead.
Let us fight with everything we've got."

And so—
their memorable debut race began.
